purpose: Static apple appearance smoke test for a local VLM; not a disease diagnostic or longitudinal benchmark.

source.title: Image Dataset of Healthy and Infected Apple Fruits for Computer Vision and Image Classification
source.download_method: HTTP byte ranges; ZIP directory and four members only. Per-member CRC32 validated; full archive checksum not checked.

selection: First two lexicographic JPEG filenames in each source class; no model-output-based selection.
limitations: Source labels healthy and infected are preserved; independent laboratory diagnosis is not established.
Not the same apple over time; no elapsed-time or onset labels.
Four examples only; cannot estimate diagnostic accuracy or cost savings for long-horizon operation.
Healthy examples share market backgrounds; infected examples share dark backgrounds, creating an obvious background confound.
Adjacent filenames may depict the same physical fruit or very similar fruit; independent fruit identity is unverified.

visual_inspection.method: Assistant image viewing, not expert annotation
visual_inspection.observation: Large foreground apple with no obvious large damaged patch visible.
